description.value:
You discharge all of your biotic barrier energy in a devastating point-blank explosion, obliterating everything around you at the cost of your defenses.

Requirements You have an active Biotic Barrier with at least 1 HP remaining.

You expend your entire Biotic Barrier in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10-foot emanation}. The damage equals the barrier's current HP at the time of detonation. All creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|basic|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-nova] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success Half damage.

Failure Full damage and pushed 5 feet away from you.

Critical Failure Double damage, pushed 10 feet away, and knocked prone.

Your Biotic Barrier is immediately depleted after using this power. Using Nova records the barrier's HP as this detonation's force damage and empties the barrier.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
